title: Stress: LiDAR outliers in an empty room
description: Nothing within 4 m between 0.6 and 2.1 m. 1 % depth noise plus 0.02 % of pixels replaced by random medium-confidence ranges (a synthetic artifact model, not measured iPhone behaviour). Any phantom pin here comes from a single stray sample.
knownIssue: Each column takes the single nearest sample with no outlier rejection, so one stray medium-confidence pixel raises a pin for a frame.
